description: This file manages memory embedding providers, including importing default models, defining types, and functions for creating and resolving embedding providers with fallback and auto-selection logic.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an unknown error into a string message.

methods.name: formatProviderError
methods.description: Formats setup errors from a provider adapter into a string message.

methods.name: shouldContinueAutoSelection
methods.description: Determines if auto-selection should continue based on an error.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves a memory embedding provider adapter by ID, throws if unknown.

methods.name: listAutoSelectAdapters
methods.description: Lists and sorts adapters eligible for auto-selection based on priority and local model path.

methods.name: resolveProviderModel
methods.description: Resolves the model name for a provider, trimming input or defaulting.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddingProviderFallbackModel
methods.description: Resolves fallback model for a provider ID, using default or fallback source.

methods.name: createWithAdapter
methods.description: Creates an embedding provider with a specific adapter asynchronously.

methods.name: createEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Main function to create an embedding provider, handling auto-selection, fallback, and errors.
